official_text: Information is required under section 133(6) regarding an investment transaction.

requests.original_text: Provide the date, amount and source of funds for the investment transaction.

plain_language_explanation.en: Give the transaction details and explain where the invested money came from.

required_evidence.name: Investment statement or confirmation
required_evidence.reason: Supports the transaction date and amount.

required_evidence.name: Bank statement showing source of funds
